summary: Wife of Patrick Heffernan, born in Tipperary about 1770; once placed among John's ancestors but no longer accepted as one.
bio: Catherine Neagle was born about 1770 in Tipperary, Ireland, and married Patrick Heffernan. Her surname is probably a form of Nagle, the name of a landed family of County Cork. She died in Ireland. She was once placed in the ancestry of Andrew H. Heffernan, but that connection has not held up, and she is no longer counted among John's ancestors.
sources: Johnny Meier's Ancestry tree (screenshots IMG_7791-7840 in John's Google Drive), transcribed in research/tree_transcription.md and Ancestry tree screenshots (section 2.2.2)

Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
